rules.anchor: Do not write it until the user signs off on every section.
rules.why: no spec file before sign-off

rules.anchor: Any other state — STOP and ask the user how to proceed.
rules.why: spec writes only from main or the ticket branch with a clean tree

rules.anchor: do not mutate the changed repository to store it
rules.why: external specs live in the notes repository only

rules.anchor: working tree clean and HEAD on `main`, otherwise STOP
rules.why: notes checkout verified before use

rules.anchor: Do not create missing context files
rules.why: no second documentation convention

rules.anchor: A missing canonical reference required by the ticket is different — STOP and surface it
rules.why: proceeding would invent a contract

rules.anchor: If a candidate file exists, STOP: this ticket is already specced.
rules.why: spec creates, flow updates

rules.anchor: If more than one candidate file exists, STOP and ask which is canonical.
rules.why: ambiguous spec location

rules.anchor: ### 2. CHECKPOINT — confirm intent with user
rules.why: intent confirmed before design

rules.anchor: Always invoke these skills at start of step 3
rules.why: no exceptions to the skill invocations

rules.anchor: STOP and alert user
rules.why: a missing required skill stops the run

rules.anchor: Inferred claim must not enter spec as though verified.
rules.why: verified/inferred split

rules.anchor: Never silently promote.
rules.why: inferred claims are verified or become open decisions

rules.anchor: Resolve composed schemas fully before concluding field present or absent.
rules.why: unresolved reference means unknown, not absent

rules.anchor: Always run security pass; scale depth to change.
rules.why: authz gaps caught before ACs

rules.anchor: ### 5. CHECKPOINT — review ACs and propose the merge sequence
rules.why: ACs and rollout reviewed with the user

rules.anchor: Do not write the sequence without user sign-off.
rules.why: rollout needs sign-off

rules.anchor: must not be able to produce conflicting behavior
rules.why: spec has no contradictions

rules.anchor: is an `## Open decisions` entry whose options are each concrete, never a blank
rules.why: flag removal conditions are never blank

rules.anchor: Do not commit `main` to a guessed interface
rules.why: spike instead of guessing

rules.anchor: ### 6. CHECKPOINT — open decisions
rules.why: open decisions resolved with the user

rules.anchor: ### 7. CHECKPOINT — self-review pass
rules.why: self-review before final review

rules.anchor: **Removed references**
rules.why: self-review searches for dropped references

rules.anchor: ### 8. CHECKPOINT — final review
rules.why: final user review before writing

rules.anchor: never force-push
rules.why: notes repository history is not rewritten

rules.anchor: Never write "the executor should choose"
rules.why: design decisions are not deferred to the executor

rules.anchor: An unknown flag name is an Open decision, never a blank
rules.why: flagged slices never carry a blank flag name

rules.anchor: scripts/spec-lint.mjs" <spec-file>
rules.why: the drafted spec is checked by the script before the user sees it

rules.anchor: names no guard
rules.why: every Relevant files entry names the check that guards it

rules.anchor: needs six cells with a Disposition
rules.why: every Contradictions row has a disposition

rules.anchor: an empty ledger reads as skipped
rules.why: a clean ledger says so explicitly

rules.anchor: has an empty Disposition
rules.why: every Security threat row carries a disposition

rules.anchor: an AC range must not expand to more than
rules.why: a regex-matched AC range cannot expand without bound

rules.anchor: part must not contain another
rules.why: a heading part never swallows a heading of its own level

rules.anchor: when the ticket touches a technology its `## Domain references` section lists
rules.why: client-specific technology references are read before ACs promise behaviour
